title: Glass room with panelled side walls, Duleek
summary: A glass room with sliding glass panels at the back of the house, closed at the sides with painted timber framed panel walls and a clear roof section.
intro: The glass room opens onto the garden through sliding glass panels. At the sides, painted timber framed panel walls give privacy from the neighbours and the side passage, with a clear roof section above to keep the light.
